slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand can be split across vehicles. The catch-all question in turn 5 ('any additional constraints... such as maximum route duration') does not target this slot, and the 'exactly once' phrasing only appears silently in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the depot operating time window of [0, 1236] minutes represent the latest time a truck must return to the depot, or is it simply the horizon within which all routes must be completed?
slot_scores.rationale: The question touches return-to-depot timing but presupposes that returning occurs; it never asks whether returning to the depot is mandatory or whether routes can be open, so the slot's key meaning is not covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each customer is served by exactly one vehicle (no split deliveries).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether a customer's demand can be split across trucks, yet asserted 'All customer demands must be met exactly once' in the confirmed understanding.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Vehicles must start at and return to the depot.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The return-to-depot requirement was never explicitly confirmed; the agent assumed it in the 'Route Continuity' constraint without asking whether routes could be open.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent declared READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden slots (single-vehicle-per-customer and depot return requirement) remained unresolved, silently assuming them instead.

summary: The agent asked several reasonable modeling questions (speed, depot horizon, fleet homogeneity, objective, catch-all constraints) but never resolved the two P1 hidden slots on split deliveries and mandatory depot return, silently assuming both before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
